settings.question: When does the sale run?
settings.answer: Our Black Friday sale runs from Saturday 21 to Friday 27 November 2026. It opens to everyone at midnight (AEDT) on the 21st.

settings.question: What are the shipping cut-offs?
settings.answer: Orders placed during the sale ship on our usual next-business-day schedule. Order early in the week to have your coffee before the weekend.

settings.question: Do discounts stack?
settings.answer: Sale pricing applies automatically at checkout and can't be combined with other discount codes.

settings.question: Can I save on a subscription too?
settings.answer: Yes — start or manage a coffee subscription any time for a standing discount on every delivery, on top of the sale.
